# Support and community

- [Report a bug](https://github.com/kristofferR/ha-adjustable-bed/issues/new?template=bug-report.yml): broken controls, connection failures, regressions, or incorrect detection.
- [Request a feature](https://github.com/kristofferR/ha-adjustable-bed/issues/new?template=feature-request.yml): missing capabilities and improvements.
- [Request bed support](https://github.com/kristofferR/ha-adjustable-bed/issues/new?template=new-bed-support.yml): an unsupported brand or model.
- [Ask a question](https://github.com/kristofferR/ha-adjustable-bed/discussions/new?category=help-questions): how to configure or use the integration.
- [Community discussions](https://github.com/kristofferR/ha-adjustable-bed/discussions): dashboards, automations, experiences, and announcements.

You do not need to prove a problem is a bug before reporting it. Include a support
bundle for bugs and compatibility requests if possible; explain any capture
failure instead of abandoning the report. General questions and feature requests
do not require diagnostics.

See [Getting Help](../docs/GETTING_HELP.md) for diagnostic instructions and
[thread states](../docs/GETTING_HELP.md#how-reports-are-handled).

## Maintainer triage

1. Search open and closed issues before creating a tracking issue.
2. When a discussion needs code, documentation, or compatibility work, create or
   link one canonical issue. Preserve the original author's attribution, source
   discussion, symptom summary, and attachment links. Do not ask them to refile.
3. Add a visible handoff in the discussion and direct progress updates to the
   issue. Close a discussion used solely as a duplicate report after the handoff;
   keep a useful community showcase or help conversation open.
4. Mark answers only when they answer the question. A request for diagnostics or
   a pointer to an unresolved bug is not a solution. Correct stale accepted answers.
5. Use `needs-info` for specific missing information, remove it when supplied,
   and leave the issue open. Do not close solely because of inactivity.
6. Close completed, declined, or duplicate topics with the outcome or destination
   explained. Lock only for moderation or intentionally read-only announcements.

Announce policy changes in the pinned welcome discussion and keep its routing
links consistent with this file, the README, issue forms, and Getting Help.
